Players Committee card image of [[Toryn Farr (V) (Errata)]] (errata PC-E1), game text: “Adds 2 to power of anything she pilots. Your total battle destiny here is +1 (+2 if piloting a transport). Once per turn, if a battle just ended here, may 'rescue' (retrieve from Lost Pile) a Rebel of ability < 3 forfeited from same location this turn.”

Source: <code>Images-HT/starwars/Virtual3-Light/large/torynfarr.gif</code> in the Players Committee's Holotable image repository, version of commit [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/commit/35aa2a66de8c2b5feeb1ad348a3a240cdc9ffbef 35aa2a6] (28 March 2021). The PC serves its card images from this repository at res.starwarsccg.org; this is an earlier version of that file.

Edits: none. The repository's bytes are uploaded unchanged.
